description:
Geospatial intelligence for drone mission planning

Stratomaps has developed a geospatial intelligence platform for drone mission planning and dynamic in-flight re-routing. Our solution computes optimal 3D flight paths by accounting for both regulatory and operational constraints: ground risk (population density), air risk (civil aviation restriction zones), terrain topography, and aircraft-specific characteristics. As conditions change, it recomputes the optimal path in real time. The technology operates over areas pre-processed through our proprietary map and satellite data pipeline. It supports use cases including long-distance delivery (logistics, as well as medical and emergency payloads such as defibrillators), civil safety (improving situational awareness for firefighters), and manufacturers' regulatory compliance (geo-caging and geo-awareness).

entityDescription:
ANAS, part of part of the Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane Group, is a major Italian company and the concessionaire for the national network of toll-free roads and motorways. The entire network is composed by more than 32.000 Kms of roads, 18.720 bridges and viaducts, 2.157 tunnels.
Its work and presence across the territory have supported the development of Italy’s road infrastructure network and continue to ensure territorial continuity. For nearly a century, it has been building the roads that connect every part of the country, managing them and maintaining their efficiency over time. It is a key player in the fields of road design, construction and maintenance and is recognised as one of the leading organisations at international level.
ANAS designs, builds and safeguards the national road infrastructure assets, thereby contributing to the development of the territory and the economy. Its commitment focuses on network safety, environmental and landscape protection, and energy efficiency. It works to strengthen the existing road network, improve access to urban areas and enhance intermodal connections.
The objective is to ensure increasingly safe and efficient mobility, also through the study and adoption of innovative technologies.In this context, Anas is highly sensitive to technological innovation and its applications and, in recent years, has launched the Anas Smart Road project, a digital infrastructure and technology to enable the development of Smart Mobility and prepare for future scenarios of connected and autonomous driving.

Network management and road safety; infrastructure development; design and construction of new works; technological innovation and sustainability are the key areas that characterise ANAS’s commitment to achieving its objectives.

description:
TrustInSoft is a software company that develops solutions that validate mission-critical software and eliminate attack vectors.

The company's products reduce cyber risks, lower the cost of designing safety-critical systems, and reduce liabilities. 

Founded in 2013, the Paris-based company produces the TrustInSoft Analyzer, an advanced static source code analyzer based on the Frama-C platform.

This unique feature was recognized by the US federal agency standardizing cybersecurity in the report to the White House NIST IR 81511. It is this uniqueness, guaranteeing the absence of defects, that makes it possible to sell TrustInSoft to major accounts in Europe, the United States and Asia. The TrustInSoft Analyzer enables software developers and integrators to exhaustively detect the most frequent and dangerous families of threats before deployment. TrustInSoft also offers professional services and expertise to formally audit safety and security-critical existing software components.

entityDescription:
Real Again Srl is an Italian deep-tech innovative startup founded in Turin in 2024, with operations in São Paulo, Brazil, operating at the intersection of Semantic AI, Digital Twin technology, Quantum-Ready computing, and immersive spatial intelligence. The company develops proprietary AI platforms and algorithmic infrastructure for complex system modelling, Earth Observation analytics, and real-time decision support, with active applications in space-enabled services, environmental monitoring, urban intelligence, and critical infrastructure management.
Real Again's core technological differentiator is a proprietary semantic graph inference engine that enables multi-source data fusion, knowledge representation, and context-aware reasoning across heterogeneous data environments. This architecture functions as an intelligent semantic layer capable of integrating satellite EO streams, in-situ sensor networks, aerial telemetry, and ground-based data sources into unified, interpretable operational models, providing the analytical backbone for space-derived service applications requiring high explainability and real-time responsiveness.
Building on this foundation, Real Again develops advanced propagation algorithms that translate complex physical dynamics, including fire spread, atmospheric dispersion, environmental risk cascades, and structural stress diffusion, into real-time, fully navigable 3D simulation environments. These algorithms incorporate multi-layer geospatial inputs, terrain morphology, meteorological modelling, and satellite-derived vegetation and thermal indices to generate high-fidelity predictive scenarios. Simulation outputs are deployed as interactive Digital Twin instances, enabling operators and decision-makers to run forward projections, stress-test intervention strategies, and monitor evolving conditions in immersive XR environments before and during real-world operations.
Real Again's Digital Twin platforms are engineered for bidirectional, live data exchange with physical systems, supporting configurable temporal prediction horizons and photorealistic XR rendering pipelines that preserve physical accuracy while enabling intuitive spatial interaction for emergency coordinators, civil protection agencies, and scientific operators.
The company's computer vision and multimodal AI capabilities include semantic segmentation, multi-temporal change detection, anomaly identification in thermal and multispectral imagery, and AI-driven scene understanding from both aerial and satellite data sources, with operational deployments spanning burn scar mapping, land cover analysis, and satellite-derived risk assessment.
Real Again's Quantum-Ready infrastructure layer embeds quantum-classical hybrid inference pipelines and variational quantum circuit interfaces within its core graph models, ensuring forward compatibility with post-classical computing environments and long-term scalability of deployed analytical platforms.
The company holds active institutional roles within the European Innovation Council and the AI Ethics Board of the City of Turin, and maintains established partnerships with research institutions, urban regeneration agencies, and aerospace organisations across Europe and South America.

SAFINA, a.s. is a Czech specialty metals producer headquartered in Vestec near Prague, with a heritage in precious and non-ferrous metals processing reaching back to the mid-19th century. The company has a long tradition in the complex processing and manufacture of products from precious and non-ferrous metals such as thermocouple wires, PGM wires, plates and tubing, sputtering targets, labware, chemicals, powders and others. Building on this metallurgical know-how, SAFINA has become one of Europe's established suppliers of gas-atomized metal powders for advanced manufacturing technologies. Metal Additive Manufacturing
Focus on Additive Manufacturing
SAFINA entered the additive manufacturing (AM) materials market in the early 2010s and has since developed a dedicated business line — SAFINA 3D Printing — supplying powders engineered for industrial AM processes. The company's powders are used in Powder Bed Fusion (PBF) and Cold Gas Spray (CGS) technologies, with a well-tuned production process that allows SAFINA to deliver powders with customer-specific grain size and chemical composition. Quality control includes sieve analysis, laser diffraction, dynamic image particle analysis, SEM, chemical analysis (ICP-OES, EDX), gas content measurement, and tap and apparent density/flow testing, ensuring consistent batch-to-batch performance for demanding AM applications. Its technology enables the generation of diverse scenarios across environments, lighting, weather, sensor viewpoints, object configurations, and edge cases.
 
The company serves defense, security, aerospace, and industrial applications, including object detection, target recognition, autonomous systems, ISR, surveillance, drone and satellite imagery, maritime monitoring, and AI model validation. AI Verse has experience working with European defense primes, armed forces, and technology partners, providing synthetic datasets and simulation capabilities to improve model robustness, reduce false positives, and accelerate AI deployment.

Company description: AI Verse is a French DeepTech company originating from INRIA, specializing in synthetic data generation for computer vision AI. At Spectricon, our purpose is to innovate towards advancing mainstream technologies of hyperspectral imaging, while at the same time making them simple, portable and smart.
By pushing the limits of spectral imaging, the company has created and globally distributes next-generation hyperspectral camera platforms that provide the industry’s highest spatial resolution and widest spectral range. Our proprietary full-frame snapscan and handheld snapshot technologies can be trained to detect micro-structures and compositions of complex materials, making these tools more accessible, smart, and easy to deploy. 
Spectricon’s advanced spectral camera technologies have earned international awards and recognition and are sold across North America, Europe, and Asia, serving a variety of sectors, such as research institutions, remote sensing, microscopy, machine vision, online sorting, food processing, forensics, and artwork analysis.

entityDescription:
M3S Italia is an Italian technology company headquartered in Rome, Italy, specialising in the development, production and commercialisation of innovative, high-technology products and services for civil and defence markets, both nationally and internationally.
The company provides full system engineering services in the aeronautical, space, airport and transportation sectors, covering the entire lifecycle from concept definition and research through design, prototyping, testing, validation and operational deployment. M3S Italia develops hardware/software integrated, turnkey solutions for public and private customers.
Core technical competencies include GNSS signal quality monitoring and analysis (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou), satellite communication (SATCOM) link assessment for GEO, MEO and LEO constellations, RF interference detection and geolocation, and advanced positioning system engineering. The company also develops UAS/drone-based solutions, including BLOS/VLOS communication architectures integrating SATCOM and GNSS technologies, autonomous UAV platforms, drone-based remote sensing and spectrum monitoring payloads.
M3S Italia has strong expertise in software engineering and artificial intelligence, developing dedicated algorithms, AI/ML-based data processing platforms, Big Data analytics, IoT and robotics systems, and digital platforms for real-time telemetry and quality reporting.

entityDescription: NordSpace is a Canadian space company delivering end-to-end mission solutions, including launch vehicles, spaceport infrastructure, and in-space hardware. Headquartered near Toronto, Canada, NordSpace brings together a highly experienced engineering and program delivery team with proven track records from successful space launch companies and across major space agency and defence programs. Its flagship Tundra launch vehicle is a fully ITAR-free, two-stage liquid bipropellant rocket on track for responsive light-lift launches to LEO/SSO by 2028, with a roadmap toward reusable medium-lift in the early 2030s, making NordSpace a competitive launch partner for European institutional and commercial payloads. NordSpace also develops a growing catalogue of in-space hardware for small satellite missions, including the Zephyr electric propulsion thruster, the Chronos edge-AI camera, and VLEO non-terrestrial networking payloads for resilient, secure communications. NordSpace operates its own Atlantic Spaceport Complex (ASX) in Newfoundland, ideally positioned to support responsive, resilient cross-Atlantic allied launches, including under initiatives such as NATO STARLIFT. With an ITAR-free product line, established collaborations with European industry and research institutions, and rigorous in-house advanced manufacturing and testing capabilities, NordSpace is well positioned to support ESA missions and joint Canada–Europe space initiatives.
